title_zh: 用碳和二氧化碳区分元素与化合物

scenario.goal_zh: 确认元素定义清楚，并商定补充化合物解释及图示标签来区分两者。

context_zh: 学生请老师检查科学展示中的术语解释和粒子图示。
author: author-phase07-a

sentences.speaker: Pia
sentences.text: Does this definition explain the concept of an element clearly enough?

sentences.speaker: Pia
sentences.text: An element contains just one type of atom. Carbon is an example.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lane
sentences.text: That's clear. What will you say about a compound?

sentences.speaker: Pia
sentences.text: That it contains atoms of different elements chemically joined together. I'll use carbon dioxide as my example.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lane
sentences.text: Good. Add labels to the two kinds of atoms in your diagram so readers can see the difference.

sentences.speaker: Pia
sentences.text: I'll label them and add the compound explanation beside the element definition.
